digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical mutant counts are stale; signing.py now generates 814 mutants versus 491 in the old record, including both equivalent survivors and real contract gaps.

Enforcement modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) are defined by manifest-driven per-shard policy with explicit promotion thresholds: advisory blocks only missing/zero-mutant/incomplete evidence; ratchet preserves unchanged legacy survivors and blocks killed regressions; strict requires every mutant killed or fingerprinted equivalent.

Selector maps changed source, test, support, and infrastructure files to affected shards, preserves rename/deletion sides, reports unmatched Python tests, and emits JSON for targeted or all-shard runs.
Each shard job runs fresh base/head archives with no cached mutation verdicts, pinned mutmut 3.7.0, max-children=1, clean-test preflight, and a 30-minute timeout per matrix job.
Manifest provides sole source for shard mappings, timeout constants (1.0 + 15.0×multiplier), enforcement modes, and equivalent survivor fingerprints; no duplicate mutmut config exists in repository.
